decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the six-pin main-to-sensor signal connector and its pinout.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the sensor-board power input connector type, pin count, and pinout.
The candidate already has a same-message INTRODUCE establishing SEL connected to GND and SPS30 I2C operation.
The sensor-board connector matrix does not change the separate power-board charge-status LED connector or circuit.
The source specifies sensor-board connectors and does not alter the main-board panel reset interface.
The source does not change any panel button, switch, GPIO, or off-board control connection.
Sensor connector power pins do not change the standalone USB regulator, activation condition, powered rail, or specified loads.
The listed sensor-board connectors do not include or modify the separate PIR input interface.
The source does not change the capacitive-touch connectors, sensors, or GPIO assignments.
The source does not address the LED supply voltage, level shifting, data interface, or power-control behavior.
The sensor-board connector count and matrix do not change the separate eight-LED array board.
The SPS30 connector's 5V pin is consistent with the existing switched-rail load assignment and introduces no change to rail control or load state.
